layout.shell_description: Left sidebar (240px, fixed, dark) with navigation links + MySimpleTodo branding on top. Main content area to the right. Top header (64px) with page title and contextual actions.

adaptation.notes: No mobile support needed, sidebar always visible, no responsive breakpoints required

screen_type_patterns.description: Task list view with search and filter (all tasks, due soon, completed)
screen_type_patterns.header_area: Page title 'All Tasks' + 'Add Task' button (button-primary), search bar (DaisyUI input), filter dropdown (DaisyUI dropdown)
screen_type_patterns.body_area: DaisyUI table with columns — title, due date, status (DaisyUI badge), actions (edit, delete, mark done). Overdue tasks highlighted with warning badge. Sorted by due date ascending.

states.display: DaisyUI loading spinner centered in table area
Friendly empty state message 'No tasks yet — click Add Task to get started' with primary 'Add Task' button below
DaisyUI alert (error) with message 'Failed to load tasks' and retry button
Table rows rendered. Status badges: done=badge-success, pending=badge-warning, overdue=badge-error

screen_type_patterns.header_area: Form title ('Add Task' or 'Edit Task') with breadcrumb back link to task list
screen_type_patterns.body_area: DaisyUI form fields — title (input-bordered), due date (date input), status (checkbox with label 'Mark as done')

states.display: Form fields empty (create) or pre-filled (edit), save button disabled until title is entered
Save button shows loading spinner, form fields disabled
DaisyUI label-error under invalid fields, red border on input. Alert at top if server error.
DaisyUI toast notification (success) appears top-right, auto-dismisses after 3s. Redirects to task list.

component_patterns.notes: DaisyUI table with hover rows. Columns: title (text), due date (formatted date), status (badge), actions (icon buttons — edit, delete). Default sort: due date ascending. Overdue tasks get badge-error on due date cell.

DaisyUI form-control layout with label-above-input. Uses input-bordered, form-control, label classes. Native date input styled with DaisyUI. Inline validation shows label-error below each invalid field.
DaisyUI alert rendered as toast, positioned top-right. Success=alert-success (green), Error=alert-error (red). Auto-dismiss after 3 seconds. Fade-out animation.

design_notes: DaisyUI theme used for consistent component styling across the app. Desktop-only layout keeps design simple — no responsive breakpoints needed.
